concept: Websites made to measure, as a tailor's tape, rendered in 3D (Blender). One made-up tape measure standing on its edge on a lilac cloth: ivory with a numeral at every centimetre on the front, violet with kinds of business on the back, a brass end and the Nexulabs wordmark as the maker's mark. Shot from the same side four ways and moving in the picture: the coil springs open, the tape is drawn through, the back goes by (garages, florists), then the brass end close up. Lilac, ivory, ink, brass and one violet.
